description: Defines classes, structs, and functions related to task execution management, including task queues, workers, execution contexts, and a manager class for handling multiple execution contexts within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: task_execution_context
classes.description: Abstract base class for execution contexts that can be stopped, named, and queried for their executors.

classes.name: task_execution_manager
classes.description: Manages multiple task execution contexts and their associated task executors.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all execution contexts managed by the task_execution_manager.

methods.name: add_execution_context
methods.description: Adds a new execution context to the manager.

methods.name: executors
methods.description: Returns a table of all task executors in the manager.

methods.name: create_execution_context
methods.description: Factory functions to create different types of task execution contexts based on provided parameters.
